response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack and backend web developer with strong software craftsmanship skills, but his background is almost entirely in web/mobile application development, DevOps, and general-purpose languages. He has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or hardware-software co-design, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Deep, long-tenured software engineering experience (15+ years) meeting seniority bar
Strong track record in low-latency systems and performance-oriented backend work (e.g., DLang async I/O at Sociomantic)
Demonstrated leadership via talks, workshops, and open-source project ownership
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or chip architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload or GPU architecture background
No hardware-software co-design or power/performance trade-off prototyping experience

key_factors.factor: No AI/DL workload optimization or GPU experience
